requirement_summary: Catastrophic Forgetting / Interference: 새 learning epoch가 과거 capability를 잃게 만들 수 있으므로 이전 Golden/Blind/Challenge capability 집합에 대한 regression을 수행하고 forgotten-capability count와 severity를 기록한다. 신규 metric 개선만으로 승격 금지.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (catastrophicForgettingCheck), assurance.learning.catastrophic-forgetting.check v2 operation; contracts/catastrophic-forgetting-check.v1.schema.json (NEW, built this pass)
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: forgotten_capabilities is computed for real from a per-capability previous_result/new_result transition (PASS->FAIL) JSON Schema cannot detect across two fields of the same array item. PROMOTION_BLOCKED is forced whenever any capability is forgotten, REGARDLESS of new_metric_improved -- directly closing '신규 metric 개선만으로 승격 금지' (promotion cannot be justified by new-metric improvement alone). Every forgotten capability is named individually (forgotten_capabilities list) alongside a count, satisfying the requirement's 'forgotten-capability count' recording obligation.
open_gap: The requirement also asks for 'severity' to be recorded per forgotten capability, not just a count/list -- this operation does not yet classify forgotten capabilities by severity (e.g. CRITICAL vs MINOR based on the capability's own criticality), treating every forgotten capability as equally blocking. Disclosed as a real, not-yet-covered refinement.
design_reference_gap: REQUIREMENT_WITHOUT_DESIGN: the trace scanner correctly excludes the requirement's own authority document (151_LEARNING_VALIDATION_OPERATIONAL_SECOND_ORDER_RISKS.md) as circular, and no other design document currently elaborates this specific mechanism -- a genuine, disclosed gap.
